svg.title: GPA 3.63 of 4.00, thesis accuracy 75.9%, 3 of 12 builds in production, 594 commits in 52 weeks
svg.desc: Four counters. GPA 3.63 on a 0 to 4.00 scale. Thesis accuracy 75.9% for the CNN + BiLSTM hybrid, against BiLSTM 73.5%, CNN 72.2% and LSTM 43.9%. 3 of the 12 builds on this page are in production. 594 commits in the last 52 weeks.
